answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 17 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the onyx solution is checked at the tundra gate and logged, the oasis audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The deposit is 72 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
